structure: constrained temperature field with a point-source inlet
recognized: ceiling and spread limits were applied to every cell, including the cell that holds the inlet
routes_tried: limits outside a jet zone around the inlet
what_failed: limits on all cells: the inlet-cell temperature changed with the mesh (40.55, 40.76, 41.00), so accepted policies were mesh-specific
what_worked: exclude a jet zone (radius 0.15 m) from the ceiling and spread, keep the floor on all cells, and show on three meshes that the constrained quantities converge
verified_by: three-mesh convergence of the constrained quantities
principle: A quantity that is constrained or optimised must converge under mesh refinement; agreement of two meshes on a tuned limit is not convergence.
failure_pattern: constraining a point-source cell and calling two agreeing meshes convergence
detected_by: independent audit by a second reader who re-ran the mesh study
signal: a constrained value that moves monotonically with the cell size, or a limit adjusted until two meshes agree

structure: dynamic programme with a multi-player rule table
recognized: a multiplier in the rules read from extracted text
routes_tried: read the multiplier as 3k for k players
read it as 3 for any k
what_failed: the 3k reading made the last level infeasible and its conclusion wrong; the statement says 3
what_worked: check the multiplier against the rendered statement page and report the result under both readings
verified_by: independent solver written by the judge from the statement
principle: A number in the rules that decides a whole level is checked against the rendered statement, and the other reading is solved too.
failure_pattern: trusting extracted text for a rule multiplier
detected_by: a blind judge solving the problem independently
signal: a result that depends on one character of the statement

problem: Heat conduction through layered clothing (sealed simulated contest, outer boundary)
structure: layered conduction with unknown surface coefficients
recognized: the outer surface was taken at the ambient temperature
routes_tried: film coefficients on both surfaces fitted to the full curve
what_failed: constant outer temperature: fit error up to about 2 C against the data, thicknesses about 2 mm too large
what_worked: film coefficients on both sides fitted to all data, with identifiability and a Laplace-domain independent solution
verified_by: fit residual, hold-out window, independent solver
principle: A boundary condition that the data contradict is rejected before it is used for design; say so with the residual.
failure_pattern: using only the final value to calibrate a coefficient and calling the model validated
signal: fit error far above the measurement resolution

recognized: activation variables for each asset with a fee threshold
routes_tried: proportional-fee relaxation for an analytic bound
what_failed: post-processing charged the fee on a rounding residue of the solver (a binary was not exactly 0)
what_worked: treat the solver activation as authoritative, round small residues explicitly, and test against exhaustive enumeration on small instances
principle: Check solver output at the tolerance of the binaries; keep a brute-force oracle for the small version of every discrete model.
failure_pattern: trusting a MILP solution without checking binary tolerances
signal: bank balance or fees that change by cents when the inputs are unchanged

recognized: a count of passed checks is reported as evidence
routes_tried: perturb the reference by 1 percent and see whether the check alarms
what_failed: 26 of 26 passed, but no one had shown the checks could fail
what_worked: mutation test: change the reference and confirm the check detects it
principle: A check counts only if it can fail: show one case where it does.
detected_by: falsification statement written for each conclusion
signal: checks that have never been seen to fail
